meta.title: Select Quote + Long-Text Capsule + Edit + Undo
meta.description: Select text to copy it or attach it to the composer as a quote chip (hover for the full text); pasting long text folds it into a capsule chip, and clicking a capsule in a sent message opens the detail drawer on the right; hover your own messages for time / copy / edit / undo — edits are sent as a new message, while undo rewinds the message, restores the files its turn changed, and refills the original text and quote chips into the composer.
